base_stage.assignment_policy: Fix all 31 retained shifts while lifting their exact rooted residual through the new factor 11.

method.exact_factorization: For every period-5040 base hole, encode the 121 lifts (x+5040*i,y+5040*j) as two little-endian bit masks. Each new tile has order 11*m with m dividing 5040, so its intersection with a compatible base hole is one exact affine line in the 11 by 11 fiber.
method.search: Start from the disclosed exploratory 24-tile lift assignment. Keep prime 23 at its qualified shift zero, and coordinate-descent the other 23 lift tiles against all 869,346,280 rooted fiber points until a complete sweep changes no shift or three sweeps complete.
method.stopping_rule: After this declaration is committed, run the frozen producer once and the source-first checker once. Retain the lift only if the checker recovers the full 55-tile family, all 3,073,593,600 point outcomes through the exact factorization, the residual root and density, and least-shift coordinate optimality for every one of the 23 movable lift tiles.

next_obligation: Choose the next compatible prime-factor lift from the exact rooted period-55440 residual, or jointly re-optimize inherited shifts under a separately frozen scope; only a zero-hole full-pool certificate can enter the affine verifier.
nonclaims: This 55-tile assignment is not an exact cover.
Coordinate-wise optimality is not global or joint optimality.
The result does not optimize the inherited period-5040 shifts or the fixed prime-23 shift.
A bounded period-55440 residual is not evidence that no finite cover exists.
The producer and checker are not a Vela Verification or Decision.

preknowledge.disclosure: Sampled 11-fiber coordinate descent and a subsequent all-hole polish observed the assignment, residual, convergence trace, and scoped coordinate optimum before this qualification was frozen.
preknowledge.effect: The iteration receives no Claim credit. Its retained value is exact source-first qualification of a reusable factor-lift method and a strictly smaller rooted residual.
